page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-32-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 252.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU. The instance configuration includes two local NVMe SSDs for high-speed local storage, though specific capacity metrics for these drives are not defined in the system specifications. It does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server type is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require a high memory-to-vCPU ratio alongside fast local scratch space. The inclusion of dedicated vCPUs and local NVMe SSD storage makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high resource density and low-latency storage access without the overhead of network-attached storage. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, caching layers, and enterprise applications that benefit from a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
